svg.title: Jev Gate run monitor
svg.desc: Animated sample of the Jev Gate run monitor. Jev calls travel from the gate stages and independent features (Tool guard, Router, Compact, Evidence) to the Jev rail and back; each reply flashes its node, updates the matching run row and adds a row to the Jev call log. Median Jev latency 248 ms.
